chirp_pacing.definition: jitter lateness = time.monotonic_ns() just before sendto - (frame first_send_ns + chirp*gap); total lateness adds frame start lateness (first_send_ns - intended_ns); sender-side only, not wire/board arrival spacing
chirp_pacing.rule: reanchor schedule (2026-11-26 user decision): valid = jitter P99 < p99 limit and min chirp spacing >= gap - p99 limit and min frame spacing >= period - p99 limit and stall frames (lateness >= 10% of period) <= 1% of frames; late_total_max_ms is reported only; lateness is measured against the re-anchored schedule
